correctness.rationale: The proof is complete in four reductions: common-divisor compression, \(q_N=3\) product uncertainty, \(q_N=4\) parity pairing, and \(q_N\ge5\) odd/CRT Meshulam bounds; the sharp construction realizes exactly two \(q_N\)-th-root zero fibers. Exact cyclotomic enumeration through \(N=36\) corroborates every regime.
